identity.modelName: ProArt GeForce RTX 4080 OC Edition 16GB GDDR6X

dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: ASUS prints three unlabeled figures. 50 mm is identified as the thickness from the same page's published 2.5-slot width (2.5 x 20.32 mm = 50.8 mm); the remaining two are length and height by graphics-card convention. This is the same derivation used for gpu.asus-dual-rtx4070-o12g.

performanceSpec.boostClockBasis: Default Mode boost as published by ASUS; the page also lists OC Mode 2625 MHz, which requires ASUS software.

notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped. From source.cat6.asus.proart-rtx4080-o16g.techspec: CUDA cores '9728', memory speed '22.4 Gbps', memory interface '256-bit', power connector '1 x 16-pin', slot width '2.5 Slot' (used above as the thickness basis), and recommended PSU '750W'. From source.cat6.nvidia.rtx4080-family.reference-tgp: 'Required System Power: 750W'. The recommended-PSU figures are not modelled -- compat2 sizes the PSU from CPU and GPU TDP with a stub headroom multiplier rather than from a vendor recommendation -- so they are recorded here rather than converted into a compat field.

evidence.basis: project-authored synthetic fixture geometry; not manufacturer-verified
